text: About Balance by Bita
Nov 11, 2026 · @Rahul Dayma
Company

Balance by Bita is a boutique medical aesthetics practice led by Bita, a nationally certified physician associate, based in Sandy Springs (Atlanta, GA) with a Chicago location in the works. Its promise: natural, impactful results that honor each patient's unique beauty.
What it offers. Injectables and regenerative treatments only:
Neuromodulators: Xeomin, Dysport, Daxxify
Dermal fillers: temple, under-eye, cheek, smile lines, lip, jawline, chin
Biostimulators and regenerative: Sculptra, hyperdilute Radiesse, PRF (platelet-rich fibrin)
New patients start with a consultation only, where Bita assesses facial structure, discusses goals and builds a custom plan. Pricing is published on the site, per unit, syringe, vial or session.

Founder story. Bita's interest began with acne at a young age. She has been an aesthetics patient herself, worked in several aesthetic roles, then trained alongside a renowned injector after becoming a physician assistant. She now runs her own practice.
Practical details. By appointment only, Monday to Friday, 10:00 am to 5:00 pm. Phone (678) 389-5910. Email balancebybita@gmail.com. A Chicago patient waitlist is open.
Audience
The site speaks to adults who want to look refreshed without looking "done," and who want a provider they trust personally.
Newcomers to injectables. The consult-only first visit and the guidance on "new to injectables or seeking expert guidance" are aimed at them.
Returning patients seeking a long-term provider. Testimonials praise being treated "more than a patient or a number" and feeling like a friend.
Patients of every background. The About page says Bita treats people across all backgrounds and ethnicities, and the hero photo shows women of different skin tones.
Atlanta-area residents first, Chicago next. Sandy Springs is the base; Chicago visitors are invited to join a priority waitlist.
People planning around life events or skincare routines. The FAQs cover weddings, peels, facials, lashes and Accutane, which suggests patients who are careful and informed about timing.
Goals
For the practice
Deliver natural, timeless results that enhance a patient's own features rather than change them.
Raise the standard of care in aesthetic medicine through a holistic approach, refined skill and personalized plans.
Build trust and lasting relationships, so patients feel known rather than processed.
Turn visitors into booked consultations: "Book Now" appears throughout the site.
Open the Chicago location and capture early demand through the waitlist.
For the patient
Look refreshed and feel confident after an appointment.
Understand their options and what to expect, including bruising, timing and aftercare.
Style and feel
The brand feels calm, feminine and editorial: luxurious, but warm rather than clinical.
Visual identity
The hero is a deep plum-brown backdrop with three women of different skin tones holding white lilies and hydrangea.
The logotype is a very large, high-contrast display serif, "balance", with a delicate script-style "by Bita" tucked beneath.
Body text is small, widely letter-spaced, uppercase sans-serif. Navigation is minimal, and the Book Appointment button is a muted rose-brown outline.
Lower sections sit on soft cream, and a low-vision accessibility menu is built in.
Colors and type are described from the homepage hero as seen in Chrome; check the exact palette and fonts with the designer.
Voice and tone
Warm, first-person and reassuring ("Hi, I'm Bita!"), with polished, aspirational language such as "precision, respect, and intention."
A recurring signature line, "you, with the cherry on top," keeps luxury friendly and approachable.
FAQ answers are direct and practical, with clear timing rules.
Overall impression
A personal, trustworthy, boutique practice where expertise and empathy come together and every face is treated with intention.
Sources
Home · About · Services · FAQs. Website design credited to Studio Soulbrand. Chicago status is unclear: the footer reads "August 2025" and the Services page offers a waitlist.
